name: 2D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization (PyTorch Reference Implementation)
definition: A PyTorch implementation of 2D Gaussian rasterization that iteratively accumulates renderings within batches of Gaussians, relying on PyTorch's autograd for backpropagation.
summary: This PyTorch reference implementation rasterizes 2D Gaussian splats into color, alpha, and normal maps, distinguishing itself through batched processing and automatic gradient computation for end-to-end learning.
